description: Create or stop the unlisted share link for one of the signed-in person's site scans. Site scans are private by default; a link lets anyone who holds it read that one scan (not the person's other scans) and stays valid until stopped. Only create a link when the person has asked to share the scan, and tell them who can open it.

action.description: "create" makes an unlisted link anyone holding it can open; "stop" turns it off so the link stops working.

job_id.description: The site scan to share or stop sharing.

name: share_site_scan
title: Share a site scan
